fan_quadrature_diagnosis.verdict: The banked ray-core total is superseded: angular refinement held the radial rule fixed, while adaptive radial integration removes the 3.2 kA bias and agrees with cellwise integration.
fan_quadrature_diagnosis.fixed_rule: four uniform triangle subdivisions and a four-point rule
fan_quadrature_diagnosis.adaptive_rule: Eight-point Gauss-Legendre radial panels doubled through 256 panels (2048 radial nodes), with the terminal total checked against independent cellwise integration; the 14 throat sectors are cross-checked at angular order 16
fan_quadrature_diagnosis.coverage_gate_note: The coverage gate compares production supports with the topology-qualified per-cell target and never uses the fan total.

diagnostics.derivative_authority: exact first and second derivatives of the RectBivariateSpline evaluated by case.flux

forbidden_territory_signed_integrals.interpretation: Each construction is integrated only on its carried core domain. Exterior cells have no ray-core intersection; production and the per-cell oracle carry exact zeros on private-flux and lower-leg labels.

root_diagnostics.oracle_uncertainty_model: per grazing ray: 2*flux_span/min_abs_hessian_eigenvalue times level_deficit**1.5 times angular_step
